At Grada

Photos from the taverna’s Google listing.

A family taverna in Oroklini

Grada is a family-owned taverna on Paideias street in Oroklini, open Tuesday to Sunday from 18:00 to 23:00. On its own menu the chef’s meze is always different, and the meat meze offers a choice of 45 dishes. Guests write about generous portions, friendly service, warm atmosphere and a chef who came out to greet the table.

The website gradataverna.wordpress.com is a free WordPress.com page: a WordPress banner sits above the header, a cookie window covers the first screen and the top photo is an old brownish one. Checked on 21 September 2026.

What guests say

From the Google listing, 4.6 stars on average across 330 reviews.

“Possibly, the best meze in Cyprus. In my opinion, it’s definitely the best. Quality food all cooked with a unique twist i.e. carrots with caraway seeds, homemade eggplant salad, pomegranate pickled flavor, oyster mushrooms instead of white mushrooms etc.”
Google review
“This place is INCREDIBLE! The meat meze is ridiculously good, every dish, every single dish! And there are 45 of them!! Even things I don’t like, have never liked in the UK, I absolutely loved here.”
Google review
“A lovely Cypriot taverna in Oroklini with authentic flavours and a warm atmosphere. Delicious traditional Cypriot dishes, generous portions, and friendly service. Perfect for a relaxed meal with real Cypriot character.”
Google review
“I recently visited Grada with a group of friends, and we were absolutely impressed! Every dish we tried was flavorful, fresh, and beautifully prepared! The service was equally amazing: friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome from the moment we walked in.”
